agent_explanation: NS green starts around step ~2090 after EW green at 2080. Detector_fail on S starts at t2144 (duration 203) in the middle of that NS green. While the failure is active the NS green is never terminated despite max_green_seconds=73 and growing conflicting demand on W (W wait 57 at 2144, 113 at 2200, 153 at 2240, 201 at 2288 with ~190-200 queued). The controller appears to treat the failed S detector as presence/extend demand (or to suspend max-out/recall while a detector in the green direction is failed), so the actuated green is extended indefinitely and the long-wait recall for W never fires, starving W past the 200s max_wait limit.
